sections.title: The letter a
paragraphs: This letter is called (а) /a/. Its main sound is heard in the word (арбуз) /ɐrˈbus/, which means watermelon. A vowel is a sound made with open air and no touch in the mouth. This letter can make three different sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, drop your jaw wide and keep your tongue low and flat. For the next sound, close your jaw slightly and pull your tongue back just a little. For the last sound, relax your jaw, keep your mouth half open, and let your tongue rest loosely. Place a hand on your throat to feel your voice buzz each time.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: When the vowel has stress, say it as in (брат) /brat/. Stress is the strength you give to one syllable. At the start of a word or right before the stressed syllable, say it like (арбуз) /ɐrˈbus/. In other unstressed syllables, say a short weak vowel as in (карандаш) /kərɐnˈdaʂ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not make this sound like the vowel in cat. That sound pulls the tongue too far forward and raises it too high. Keep your tongue low and flat, like the vowel in the word calm. Do not hold unstressed vowels too long. Keep them brief and weak.
